buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): RITES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: By Consignee agasint RITES inspection certificate 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PFA/NER/GKP payable at Gorakhpur . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also

(besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PFA/NER/GKP payable at Gorakhpur . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/NER/GKP A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidders to attach Valid Bid specific Authorization Certificate from OEM, in case firm is not O EM or firm's credential is not verified by OEM on GEM platform (With out this offer shall be tr eated as unresponsive and shall be ignored) 2. Bidders to attach Declaration from OEM regarding local content in compliance Public Procur ement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017 if not declared on product page of offered p roduct. (Without this offer shall be treated as unresponsive and shall be ignored) 3. Bidder to note that Techno-commercial evaluation will be done on the basis of documents uploaded by the bidder & no additional documents will be considered at representation time other than historical documents in compliance to Para 7.3.5 of Manual for Procurement of G oods & services. 4. The bidder has to deposit EMD/PBG in the beneficiary's Name of "PFA/NER/G KP" and has to be sent to this office address at "Office of the "Deputy Chief Material Manager General Store s Depot, Gorakhpur - 273012" in compliance of bid requirement regarding EMD. 5. Onus of submission of required documents correctly at respective tab provided in GeM bid is on Bidders only. Bidder are advised to strictly adhered the same for techno-commercial eval uation. 6. Bidders are advised to read the bid document carefully before quoting in this bid. Any reque st regarding Modification in terms and conditions/material specification/description/inspectio n clause etc. post contract will not be considered. No delivery period re-fixation after expiry of original delivery period will be entertained in this regard. 7. As per the 30% past performance criterion, the firm should have supplied at least 01 No. of the tend ered item (500 KVA or higher capacity) to any Central Government/State Government/PSU organizat ion. 8. The bidders should mandatorily submit joint note copy attached in Para 6 of Buyer added specific te rms and conditions pertaining to site visit, without which the offer will not be considered and will be summarily rejected. Name of the concerned person with Designation are mention ed below: (1) Na me of nominated concerned person- Sh. Arvind Nath Tripathi (2) Designation - AEE/Colony/NER/GKP. The bidder shall inspect the proposed site before submission of the bid and submit a Site Vi sit/Joint note along with the bid, duly signed by the bidder's authorized representative/OEM and the concerned controlling officer/ Railway representative as per annexure attached. 9. Service & Support: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre at Consignee's Location i.e. G orakhpur. The bidder shall submit documentary proof of the service center along with a valid agreement/deed executed with the OEM, wherever applicable. Submission of service center details and the agreement/deed at the time of bid with the OEM is mandatory. Payment shal l not be released until these documents are furnished and verified. Bidder/OEM must declare Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation

Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 10. The bidder shall upload valid Electrical Contractors License (Class ‘A’) issued by any State Governm ent in their own name or in the name of the OEM along with the offer for carrying out the work, failin g which the offer shall be summarily rejected. 11. Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 2 years from the date of completion of installation , commissioning & testing of goods, at consignee location and submission of commissioning report d uly signed by Firm and Railway Representative. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Su ccessful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goo ds in case of any break down during the guarantee period. 12. Bidders have to submit an ink signed (not pasted) or digital signature of authorized person/OEM and duly stamped compliance certificate on its letter head of technical specific ation document attached along with requisite documents with further stating that all terms and conditions including ATC have been read, understood and accepted. 13. A bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) from the OEM is mandatory and must be sub mitted along with the bid. The MAF will be verified with the issuing authority of the OEM. Please inclu de a contact number and email ID on the MAF for verification purposes. Bids without the MAF will be technically disqualified. 14. Any damage during transportation/installation/testing and commissioning will be sole responsibility of the seller. 15. Commissioning includes making foundation, testing of all parameters, indication and alarm system, monitoring of all parameters as per attached commissioning report proforma (Anne xure-I). 16. All other terms and conditions shall be also applicable as mentioned in technical specificatio n. . 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
